description: Use this when an owner wants their place live on Phorme: its page on phor.me, the app's map and the Phorme connector. Confirm with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. Going live needs an email for booking confirmations and requests: request_email, else the place's own, else the account's. Listing is free; when someone asks to book a place that is not on the gym plan, the ask is held 7 days and the owner is told. It takes no payment and starts no plan. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to putting this place live.

place_id.description: The place_id of one of the owner's places, from get_gym_report or create_or_claim_place.

request_email.description: Where booking confirmations and requests are emailed. Never shown in public.

name: publish_place

place.description: The place: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, address, hours, about, book_url, request_email, prices, phone, timezone, status (draft or live), page_url, upcoming_classes, brain_id, on_plan, held_requests and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link; null when on the plan).

title: Put my place live
